statements.reason: The passage specifies water, but does not say it must be distilled.
statements.statement: The normally specified coolant for the HMMWV (M998-series) engine cooling system is a 50/50 mixture of ethylene-glycol antifreeze and distilled water.

statements.reason: The passage describes the cooling system's function, but does not say the mixture provides optimal cooling performance.
statements.statement: Under normal operating conditions, this 50/50 mixture provides optimal cooling performance in the HMMWV (M998-series) engine cooling system.

statements.reason: The passage does not state a freezing-prevention benefit.
statements.statement: Under normal operating conditions, this 50/50 mixture prevents freezing in the HMMWV (M998-series) engine cooling system.

evidence_quotes:
Normally a 50-50 mixture of water and ethylene glycol base antifreeze
will be used.

The cooling system dissipates heat generated from combustion and
maintains the engine operating temperature at its most efficient level.
statements.reason: The passage identifies the normally used mixture and says the cooling system dissipates heat and maintains the engine's operating temperature.
statements.statement: Under normal operating conditions, this 50/50 mixture protects the HMMWV (M998-series) engine from overheating.
